item.title: His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani met Hendrik Wüst, Minister-President of North Rhine-Westphalia, at Drachenburg Castle…
item.description:
His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani met Hendrik Wüst, Minister-President of North Rhine-Westphalia, at Drachenburg Castle on Saturday, in a new stop on his visit to Germany. His Highness stressed Qatar's commitment to expanding economic cooperation drawing on the state's industrial and research expertise, while Wüst highlighted the importance of Qatari investment to the German economy and to his state's economy, and expressed keenness to open new avenues of cooperation.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/21/hh-the-amir-meets-minister-president-of-state-of-north-rhine-westphalia · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/21/11/2026/%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%88-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D9%8A%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%82%D9%8A-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B4%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A7 · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/21/%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%88-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D9%8A%D9%84%D8%AA%D9%82%D9%8A-%D8%B1%D8%A6%D9%8A%D8%B3-%D9%88%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%A1-%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B4%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%84-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D8%A7%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%B3%D8%AA%D9%81%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A7

item.title: HE Sheikh Saoud bin Abdulrahman bin Hassan Al Thani, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of State for Defence Affairs, met Admiral Charles B…
item.description:
HE Sheikh Saoud bin Abdulrahman bin Hassan Al Thani, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of State for Defence Affairs, met Admiral Charles Bradford Cooper, Commander of US Central Command, and his delegation during their visit to Doha. The two sides discussed several issues of mutual interest and ways to strengthen and develop them, in the presence of senior officers and officials from both sides.

item.title: Qatar face Egypt tomorrow, Sunday, in the second round of Group A at the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026, after a 2-0 opening win over Panam…
item.description:
Qatar face Egypt tomorrow, Sunday, in the second round of Group A at the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026, after a 2-0 opening win over Panama, with hopes pinned on Hadi Khalil and Diaa Al Din Al Arabi. Egypt want to make amends for a 2-1 defeat to Greece, played with 10 men after Daniel Tamer was sent off in the 23rd minute. On the same day, Saudi Arabia seek redemption against France.

item.title: The Qatar Olympic Committee used the opening day of the 40th FIVB World Congress in the Dominican Republic to showcase Qatar's preparations…
item.description:
The Qatar Olympic Committee used the opening day of the 40th FIVB World Congress in the Dominican Republic to showcase Qatar's preparations to host the 2029 Men's World Championship, the first in the Middle East and the Arab world. Sheikha Asma Al Thani presented "The Road to 2029" for a tournament bringing together 32 national teams in 64 matches over 17 days.

item.description:
Visit Qatar has launched the "Hayyakum Bein Ahlikum" initiative to welcome visitors arriving overland from GCC countries in vehicles with non-Qatari plates, offering a QR150 digital fuel voucher from WOQOD and a free Vodafone Qatar eSIM, while stocks last and with prior registration. item.title: The Qatar Meteorology Department warned of strong winds and high seas offshore today, with gusts up to 26 knots, waves up to 8 feet at time…
item.description:
The Qatar Meteorology Department warned of strong winds and high seas offshore today, with gusts up to 26 knots, waves up to 8 feet at times and a high of 30°C in Doha. It also flagged an increased chance of mist and fog at night and in the early morning from tomorrow, Sunday 22 November, until the end of the week, which may reduce horizontal visibility, and urged motorists to take care.
Sources: Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/21/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B1%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%AD%D8%B0%D8%B1-%D9%85%D9%86-%D8%B1%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AD-%D9%82%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AC-%D8%B9%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%B9%D8%B1%D8%B6-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%AD%D8%B1 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/21/11/2026/fog-formation-may-reduce-visibility-in-qatar-next-week

item.title: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Saturday they had shot down two US drones over the Strait of Hormuz: an MQ-9 with a new air defence sys…
item.description:
Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Saturday they had shot down two US drones over the Strait of Hormuz: an MQ-9 with a new air defence system, which they called the 58th since the war began, and later an MQ-1 over Qeshm Island, the 19th of its type. US Central Command, for its part, said its naval blockade of Iran had now lasted 130 days, while the IRGC navy claimed two tankers had struck mines near Khasab and Ghanem Island.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/21/irans-irgc-downs-us-drone-over-hormuz-as-efforts-to-end-war-remain-stalled · APA https://en.apa.az/asia/iran-claims-to-have-destroyed-19th-us-mq-1-drone-537641 · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/21/3082201

item.title: Saudi Arabia's Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) announced that a domestic minimum top-up tax will apply from 1 January 2027, so tha…
item.description:
Saudi Arabia's Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority (ZATCA) announced that a domestic minimum top-up tax will apply from 1 January 2027, so that profits of entities of multinational groups in the kingdom face an effective rate of at least 15%. It covers groups with consolidated revenues of at least EUR 750 million in at least two of the four preceding years, and excludes purely domestic companies.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/business/tax-news/saudi-arabia-to-introduce-15-minimum-tax-on-multinational-companies-from-2027-1.500755589 · Saudi Gazette https://saudigazette.com.sa/article/666380/saudi-arabia/saudi-arabia-to-introduce-domestic-minimum-top-up-tax-for-multinationals-effective-jan-1-2027

item.title: The Gulf Cooperation Council condemned in the strongest terms the continued Israeli attacks on Palestinians in the Gaza Strip. Secretary Ge…
item.description:
The Gulf Cooperation Council condemned in the strongest terms the continued Israeli attacks on Palestinians in the Gaza Strip. Secretary General Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi said in a statement on Saturday that bombarding civilians is a flagrant violation of international humanitarian law and that continuing the attacks despite the ceasefire undermines de-escalation efforts, reaffirming GCC support for a Palestinian state on the 4 June 1967 borders with East Jerusalem as its capital.

item.title: GCC Secretary General Jasem Albudaiwi told the Mediterranean Dialogues 2026 forum in Naples that this year's developments and their impact …
item.description:
GCC Secretary General Jasem Albudaiwi told the Mediterranean Dialogues 2026 forum in Naples that this year's developments and their impact on energy and food prices and shipping had shown how closely Gulf security is tied to global economic stability. He said GCC states had held to de-escalation and dialogue and kept energy flowing to markets, including Europe, while expanding their non-oil sectors.

item.title: Trading value on the Muscat Stock Exchange rose 19% last week to OMR 238.2 million, the third weekly gain in a row, supported by buying fro…
item.description:
Trading value on the Muscat Stock Exchange rose 19% last week to OMR 238.2 million, the third weekly gain in a row, supported by buying from local funds and institutions, which accounted for 85.6% of trading. But with 49 securities falling against 20 gaining, the main index closed at 7,259 points, down about 95 points on the week.

item.title: Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty and his Sudanese counterpart Mohieldin Salem signed, on the sidelines of the Aswan Forum, a memorandum of u…
item.description:
Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty and his Sudanese counterpart Mohieldin Salem signed, on the sidelines of the Aswan Forum, a memorandum of understanding between the Egyptian Agency of Partnership for Development and Sudan's foreign ministry on training and capacity building. Abdelatty also held a trilateral meeting with Salem and Eritrean Foreign Minister Osman Saleh, which stressed Red Sea security, freedom of navigation and building on the outcomes of last October's El Alamein consultative summit.

item.title: Syria's General Authority of Civil Aviation announced that Syrian Airlines will operate scheduled direct flights between Damascus and Cairo…
item.description:
Syria's General Authority of Civil Aviation announced that Syrian Airlines will operate scheduled direct flights between Damascus and Cairo from 5 December, and between Aleppo and Cairo from 7 December. Authority head Omar Al-Husari said the resumption implements understandings reached with Egypt in Montreal, including simultaneous operation by Syrian and Egyptian carriers.

item.title: Transport Minister Lt Gen Kamel El-Wazir made his second inspection tour in 48 hours of stations in Cairo, Tanta, Sidi Gaber and Alexandria…
item.description:
Transport Minister Lt Gen Kamel El-Wazir made his second inspection tour in 48 hours of stations in Cairo, Tanta, Sidi Gaber and Alexandria, under the urgent plan to step up maintenance and raise railway safety. He ordered strict use of automatic train control (ATC) throughout journeys, more surprise inspections and timetables reorganised according to passenger density.

item.title: The gold pound in Egypt lost about EGP 4,120 over the week, from 47,720 to 43,600, while the 21-carat gram fell about EGP 515 to 5,450, dow…
item.description:
The gold pound in Egypt lost about EGP 4,120 over the week, from 47,720 to 43,600, while the 21-carat gram fell about EGP 515 to 5,450, down 8.63%, according to the iSagha platform. This came as the ounce dropped globally to about USD 3,538, its biggest weekly loss in eight months, while the decline revived sales in the local market.

Egypt's U-17 side under Hussein Abdel Latif face hosts Qatar tomorrow, Sunday, in the second round of Group A at the U-17 World Cup, seeking to make up for their 2-1 opening defeat to Greece. item.title: The Russian cargo ship Sparta II, bound from St Petersburg to Kaliningrad, was hit by two drones on Saturday morning west of Gogland Island…
item.description:
The Russian cargo ship Sparta II, bound from St Petersburg to Kaliningrad, was hit by two drones on Saturday morning west of Gogland Island in the Gulf of Finland, caught fire and drifted into Finnish territorial waters. Finland imposed temporary air and sea traffic restrictions in the eastern gulf and notified its allies, and Prime Minister Petteri Orpo said "war is spilling over into our immediate vicinity", while Kaliningrad's governor said supplies to the exclave were not at risk.

item.title: Denmark has urged EU countries, in a diplomatic message, to suspend tourist visas for Russian citizens and stop recognising non-biometric R…
item.description:
Denmark has urged EU countries, in a diplomatic message, to suspend tourist visas for Russian citizens and stop recognising non-biometric Russian passports across the Schengen zone, after announcing it had foiled what it said was a Russian intelligence plot to assassinate a US-Ukrainian rapper. EU ambassadors are due to discuss the proposals in Brussels on Monday 23 November, while the Russian embassy rejected the accusations.

item.title: Talks at the COP31 climate summit in Antalya ran into Saturday after missing their Friday evening deadline, with nearly 200 countries split…
item.description:
Talks at the COP31 climate summit in Antalya ran into Saturday after missing their Friday evening deadline, with nearly 200 countries split over mentioning fossil fuels and over finance. The updated draft dropped every reference to fossil fuels across its 80 articles, while African ministers demanded that adaptation finance be tripled to USD 120 billion a year by 2035.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/21/cop31-climate-talks-overrun-in-dispute-over-final-deal/ · Health Policy Watch https://healthpolicy-watch.news/cop31-draft-deal-drops-fossil-fuels-references-as-final-session-goes-into-overtime/

item.title: At least four Palestinians were killed in Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip on Saturday, three of them in a drone strike on a vehicle deliv…
item.description:
At least four Palestinians were killed in Israeli attacks on the Gaza Strip on Saturday, three of them in a drone strike on a vehicle delivering food aid to displaced people in the Tal al-Hawa neighbourhood of western Gaza City, and another shot in the Halawa displacement camp in the north. The toll since the 11 October 2025 ceasefire has risen to 1,671 killed and 6,062 injured, and to 74,736 killed since October 2023.
